newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SKI JUMPING-PETERKA, 17, WINS FOUR HILLS TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: SKI JUMPING-PETERKA, 17, WINS FOUR HILLS TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Seventeen-year-old Primoz Peterka became the first Slovenian to clinch the coveted Four Hills tournament when he finished third in the final event on Monday.
Peterka earned 971.5 points overall from the four jumps in the German resorts of Oberstdorf and Garmisch Partenkirchen and in the Austrian towns of Innsbruck and Bischofshofen.
Ski flying world champion Andreas Goldberger of Austria was second behind Peterka in the Four Hills with 943.2 -- just one-tenth of a point ahead of German Dieter Thoma.
Thoma won Monday's leg in Bischofshofen with jumps of 124.5 and 126 metres, earning 250.40 points from the judges.
He also won the first of the Four Hills competitions in Oberstdorf in December.
Peterka leads the World Cup overall standings with 632 points, ahead of Thoma (540) and Goldberger (514).
